content: Sɔn si su ɡbiisi turɑre kowon ɡum sɔɔ, su rɑ ɡum mɛ sɑnkuwɑ. Nɡe mɛyɑ ɡɑri bɑkɑ kookoosu bɑɑ sin fiiko su rɑ bwisi kɑ bɛɛrɛ kɑwe.
Bwisiɡiin ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ rɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ dee dee. Adɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔɡuu ɡɑ ku rɑ dee dee swĩi.
Gɑri bɔkɔ ù n sĩimɔ swɑɑ sɔɔ, bwisi yi rɑ n nùn kɔmiɛwɑ kpɑ u n bɑɑwure sɔ̃ɔsimɔ mɑ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ.
Wunɛn yinni ù n kɑ nun mɔru seewɑ, ɑ ku wunɛn sɔmburu deri. Domi tii nɛnubu bu rɑ torɑ dɑbinu ɡbɑrewɑ.
Nɑ torɑru ɡɑru wɑ hɑnduniɑ ye sɔɔ te tɑ wee kpɑrobun min di.
Terɑ, bɑ rɑ ɡɑsɔ ɡɑri bɑkɑsu ɑye dɑmɡinu wɛ̃, kpɑ bu tɔn bɛɛrɛɡibu ɑye piiminu wɛ̃.
Mɛyɑ, nɑ wɑ yobu bɑ dumi sɔni mɑ sinɑmbu bɑ kɑ nɑɑsu sĩimɔ nɡe yobu.
Wi u suurɑ ɡbemɔ, wiyɑ u koo kpĩ u wɔri ye sɔɔ. Wi u mɑɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑru surɑmɔ kpɑ wɑɑ yu nùn dɔm.
Wi u kpenu suɑmɔ, u koo mɛɛrɑ wɑ. Wi u mɑɑ dɑ̃ɑ bɛrɑmɔ, u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ kɑri sɔɔ.
Win ɡbɑ̃ɑ yɑrɑ yɑ̀ kun nɔɔ do, mɑ u ǹ ye nɔɔ dɛ̃ɛre, tilɑsiwɑ u kɑ dɑ̃ɑ ye kĩi kɑ dɑm bɑkɑm. Adɑmɑ bwisiyɑ yi rɑ de ɡɑ̃ɑnu nu koorɑ.
Wi u wɑɑ sɑbuɑ, mɑ yɑ nùn dɔmmɔ, ɑrufɑɑni yerɑ̀ u mɔ.
A kun dɑ ɡɑri sɑɑri too
Bwisiɡiin ɡɑri yi rɑ n bɛɛrɛ mɔ. Adɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔn ɡɑri yi rɑ ɡu kɑm koosiewɑ.
U rɑ ɡɑri torewɑ kɑ ɡɑri bɑkɑru kpɑ u yi wiru ɡo kɑ wiirɑ ɡɑri kɔ̃si.
U rɑ n ɡɑri sɑɑrimɔwɑ too. Adɑmɑ tɔnu, ɑ ku rɑ n yɛ̃ ye yɑ koo nùn deemɑ. Goo mɑɑ sɑri wi u koo nun sɔ̃ ye yɑ koo koorɑ wunɛn ɡɔɔn biru.
Gɑri bɔkɔ ɡɑ rɑ tii wɑsirɑru dokewɑ sɔmburu bɑɑtere sɔɔ. Mɛyɑ u ku rɑ mɑɑ kpĩ u dɑ wuu sɔɔ.
Bɔ̃rurɑmɑ tem mɛ̀ sɔɔ ɑluwɑɑsi ɡɑri bɔkɔ u sɑ̃ɑ sunɔ mɑ mɛn sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu bɑ rɑ n ben tiin nukurun ɡɑri mɔ̀ mɛ̀n nɔɔ yɑm sɑ̃rɑ.
Doo nɔɔruɡibɑ be bɑ sunɔ mɔ wi u yĩsiru yɑrɑ, mɑ win sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu bɑ rɑ di dim sɑɑ sɔɔ bu kɑ dɑm wɑ, n ǹ mɔ bu kɑ tɑm nɔ.
Wi u yikuru mɔ, win dirun kpɛɛru tɑ rɑ kpunɛwɑ kpɑ tɑ n nim dumɔ.
Dɑmɡibu bɑ rɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ dim kowɑ bu kɑ nuku dobu ko. Tɑm mu rɑ bu nuku dobu wɛ̃ kpɑ ɡobi yi de bu kpuro wɑ.
A ku sinɑ boko wĩi, bɑɑ wunɛn ɡɔ̃ruɔ. A ku mɑɑ yiikoɡii wĩi, bɑɑ ɑsiri sɔɔ. À n kuɑ mɛ, ɡunɔ ɡɑ koo wunɛn ɡɑri yi suɑ ɡu kɑ dɑ ɡu nùn sɔ̃ ye ɑ ɡeruɑ.
